sloka: विष्णुना च पुरा राम भृगु पत्नी पतिव्रता ।अनिन्द्रम् लोकम् इच्छन्ती काव्यमाता निषूदिता ॥१-२५-२१॥
transliteration: viṣṇunā ca purā rāma bhṛgu patnī pativratā ।anindram lokam icchantī kāvyamātā niṣūditā ॥1-25-21॥

translations.english: O Prince by these magnanimous persons and by great men several unrighteous women were killed for the common good". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
